expressionEncoding: a bit word b1...bn denotes the closed right-associated type T(b1) -> ... -> T(bn) -> Unit

pairConstruction.relation: the length-(2r+2) cyclic cores are rotations, and both linearizations append their common 0^r prefix

boundedDetector: root prefix of length r, terminal suffix of length r, and the multisets of all contiguous labelled windows of lengths 1 through r+1
theoremScope: The construction works for every positive integer r, not only the tested radii. Rotation preserves cyclic window counts; appending the common r-symbol prefix converts them to identical linear window decks through length r+1 while retaining distinct global words.
boundary: This is a no-go for bounded local window bags on a valid closed Lean-type family. It is not a no-go for unbounded rooted paths or full canonical expression hashes.
